Azure Bee.name: Azure Bee
Azure Bee.description: A calm bee infused with cool energy, boosting blue pollen collection and refreshing nearby flowers. Its soothing aura increases efficiency and supports allies, making it essential for steady resource gathering and growth.

obtain.detail: Silver Egg can hatch a Rare or Epic Bee.

Basic Bee.name: Basic Bee
Basic Bee.description: A simple and reliable bee with balanced abilities. It gathers pollen steadily, converts resources efficiently, and supports your hive with consistent performance. Perfect for beginners building a strong and dependable foundation.

obtain.detail: Basic Egg can hatch Basic Bee.

Bomber Bee.name: Bomber Bee
Bomber Bee.description: A destructive bee that drops explosive bombs, instantly collecting pollen from surrounding flowers. Its powerful blasts clear large areas quickly, making it perfect for fast farming and overwhelming field coverage.

obtain.detail: Silver Egg can hatch a Rare or Epic Bee.

Cloud Bee.name: Cloud Bee
Cloud Bee.description: A celestial bee adrift in an endless sky, its body woven from billowing cumulus clouds. It summons gusts of swirling wind to scatter pollen far across the field, enveloping nearby flowers in a soft, misty vapor that suspends decay and magnifies pollen yield while its airy aura drifts through the area in a sweeping, ever-shifting current of boundless atmospheric energy.

obtain.detail: Diamond Egg can hatch a Legendary Bee.

Coal Bee.name: Coal Bee
Coal Bee.description: A smoldering bee forged from deep earth pressure. It scorches nearby flowers, hardening their cores and boosting red pollen collection while radiating raw heat that fuels efficiency and ensures relentless, unyielding resource extraction.

obtain.detail: Gold Egg can hatch an Epic or Legendary Bee.

Cold Bee.name: Cold Bee
Cold Bee.description: A chilling bee infused with icy power. It freezes nearby flowers, slowing decay and boosting blue pollen collection while providing cooling effects that improve efficiency and help maintain stable resource gathering performance.

obtain.detail: Gold Egg can hatch an Epic or Legendary Bee.

Crimson Bee.name: Crimson Bee
Crimson Bee.description: A fierce bee filled with blazing power, specializing in red pollen collection and aggressive boosts. It enhances attack strength and burns through fields quickly, helping your hive dominate and collect resources faster.

obtain.detail: Silver Egg can hatch a Rare or Epic Bee.

Exp Bee.name: Exp Bee
Exp Bee.description: A luminous bee glowing with concentrated knowledge and energy. It flits purposefully through the field, leaving trails of sparkling wisdom and radiant experience orbs in its wake while its brilliant aura resonates with an empowering frequency that accelerates growth and amplifies the learning gained from every blossom it touches.

Firework Bee.name: Firework Bee
Firework Bee.description: A radiant bee crackling with festive power. It detonates cascading bursts across the field, showering flowers in luminous sparks and amplifying pollen yield while its brilliant explosions ripple outward, fueling a dazzling and relentless surge of collection.

obtain.detail: Diamond Egg can hatch a Legendary Bee.

Flower Bee.name: Flower Bee
Flower Bee.description: A gentle bee devoted to nurturing flowers. It enhances bloom speed, increases pollen yield from blossoms, and spreads growth energy across fields, making nearby plants more rewarding and efficient to harvest.

obtain.detail: Gold Egg can hatch an Epic or Legendary Bee.

Hasty Bee.name: Hasty Bee
Hasty Bee.description: An energetic bee that increases movement speed and attack rate for the hive. Its rapid actions help collect pollen faster, dodge threats, and improve overall efficiency during intense gathering sessions.

obtain.detail: Silver Egg can hatch a Rare or Epic Bee.

Ice Bee.name: Ice Bee
Ice Bee.description: A crystalline architect carved from eternal permafrost, shimmering with a frigid, silent grace. It glides through the air on wings of sheer frost, trailing a mist of absolute zero and delicate snowflakes that freeze moments of insight into permanent memory; its chilling aura stills the chaos of the mind, allowing for a focused, rhythmic harvest of clarity from the petals of the frozen field.

Icicle Bee.name: Icicle Bee
Icicle Bee.description: A frigid bee encased in piercing ice. It launches razor-sharp icicles across the field, freezing nearby flowers in a crystalline frost that slows decay and amplifies pollen yield while its glacial aura blankets the area in a relentless, bone-chilling surge of frozen energy.

obtain.detail: Diamond Egg can hatch a Legendary Bee.

Lucky Bee.name: Lucky Bee
Lucky Bee.description: A shimmering bee radiating with golden fortune. It dances unpredictably across the field, scattering bursts of lucky clover and glittering tokens wherever it roams while its warm, glowing aura pulses with a magnetic charm that draws in rare treasures and multiplies the rewards of every flower it graces.

Magma Bee.name: Magma Bee
Magma Bee.description: A core-heated sentinel forged from molten stone and pulsing obsidian. As it drones through the hive, it leaves a scorching trail of liquid fire and crystalline embers; its very presence radiates an intense, transformative heat that tempers raw potential into hardened skill, refining the essence of every flower it visits into a potent, concentrated nectar of power.

Oil Bee.name: Oil Bee
Oil Bee.description: A viscous bee gleaming with dark iridescence, its form composed of flowing obsidian streams that ripple with rainbow sheens. It releases thick, amber droplets that coat the field in protective resin, encasing nearby flowers in a preserving glaze that extends their lifespan and intensifies their essence while its slick aura spreads through the area in slow, deliberate waves of liquid preservation and ancient, earthbound energy.

obtain.detail: Diamond Egg can hatch a Legendary Bee.

Pixel Bee.name: Pixel Bee
Pixel Bee.description: A retro-inspired bee built from blocks of pure nostalgia. Its pixelated form may look simple, but don't be fooled — beneath those sharp edges lies a surprisingly capable worker. A charming collectible for those who appreciate the classics.

Science Bee.name: Science Bee
Science Bee.description: An analytical bee equipped with experimental apparatus that converts collected resources into research data. Its methodical approach increases token quality through systematic observation, occasionally discovering rare specimens and bonus materials that other bees would overlook during standard gathering operations.

obtain.detail: Silver Egg can hatch an Rare or Epic Bee.

Sound Bee.name: Sound Bee
Sound Bee.description: A resonant bee vibrating with sonic frequency. It reverberates through nearby flowers, amplifying their bloom and boosting echo pollen collection while emitting harmonic waves that sharpen efficiency and sustain a rhythmic, uninterrupted resource flow.

obtain.detail: Gold Egg can hatch an Epic or Legendary Bee.

Thunder Bee.name: Thunder Bee
Thunder Bee.description: A tempestuous bee crackling with electric fury, its form wreathed in storm clouds that pulse with veins of lightning. It calls forth thunderous roars that shake the earth and ignite the air with cascading bolts, charging nearby flowers with raw electrical energy that accelerates their growth while its crackling aura surges through the area in violent, electrifying waves of pure storm-born power.

obtain.detail: Diamond Egg can hatch a Legendary Bee.

Water Bee.name: Water Bee
Water Bee.description: A fluid bee coursing with tidal energy. It hydrates nearby flowers, accelerating growth and boosting aqua pollen collection while generating gentle currents that enhance efficiency and help sustain a steady, flowing resource output.

obtain.detail: Gold Egg can hatch an Epic or Legendary Bee.

Wave Bee.name: Wave Bee
Wave Bee.description: An oceanic bee flowing like liquid starlight, its body formed from cascading tidal currents that shimmer with deep blue luminescence. It conjures rhythmic pulses of crystalline water that wash over the field in gentle, nourishing waves, bathing nearby flowers in healing moisture that enhances their vitality while its fluid aura ebbs and flows through the area in endless, hypnotic cycles of aquatic serenity.

obtain.detail: Diamond Egg can hatch a Legendary Bee.

Windy Bee.name: Windy Bee
Windy Bee.description: A translucent spirit of the atmosphere, composed of swirling zephyrs and captured starlight. It moves with a restless, unpredictable elegance, leaving behind spiraling slipstreams of inspiration and echoing whispers of ancient secrets; its breezy resonance lifts the spirit, accelerating the pace of discovery and carrying the pollen of innovation across vast distances with a single, effortless gust.
